The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] '''A295 blaster rifle''' was the standard-issue rifle used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. It was favored by marksmen for its high accuracy and effectiveness at range.<ref name="ccg" /> A [[A295 sniper rifle|sniper variant]] also existed.

==Behind the scenes==
The prop for the A295 was based on the German [[Wikipedia:StG 44|StG 44]], the first mass-produced assault rifle issued during [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].
